blocks.text: Petrochemicals woh compounds (chemicals) hain jo zyada tar crude oil aur natural gas se refining aur transformation (shakal badalne) ke zariye hasil hote hain. In se rozana ki bohat si cheezein banti hain jo kai industries mein kaam aati hain, jaise packaging, construction, textile (kapra), electronics aur medical.

Petrochemicals se banaye gaye synthetic chemicals ya substances petrochemicals ke derivatives (un se bani cheezein) kehlate hain, aur yeh bohat ahem industrial products hain. Derivatives banane ke liye petrochemicals par chemical reactions kiye jate hain, jaise polymerization, oxidation ya substitution, aur is se rozana zindagi ke bohat ahem materials milte hain. Kuch petrochemicals, un ke derivatives aur uses Table 31.5 mein hain.

blocks.caption: Table 31.5 Petrochemicals ke derivatives aur un ke uses
rows: Aik baar use hone wale cup, insulation
Kapre, libas (fleece, jerseys) aur upholstery (sofe ka kapra)

blocks.prompt: Petrochemical aur us ke derivative mein kya farq hai? Misal dein.
blocks.explanation: Petrochemical seedha crude oil ya natural gas se milta hai (maslan ethene). Derivative us petrochemical par aage chemical reaction, jaise polymerization, kar ke banta hai (maslan poly(ethene)).

items: Petrochemicals crude oil aur natural gas se milte hain.
Derivatives polymerization, oxidation ya substitution se bante hain (Table 31.5).
